traits.name: brave
traits.reason: Lines claim bravery and a bridge was built, but recent actions are only moving, eating and taking berries; no costly build or tense moment is shown.

traits.name: cheerful
traits.reason: Lines are consistently upbeat with small flourishes like 'Worth every plank' and 'the storehouse will thank me'.

traits.name: steadfast
traits.reason: He stays near Neverland, mentions stores, farm and mending roads as duty, and says staying put is the bravest thing, though the farm work is mostly promised, no

traits.name: protective
traits.reason: He talks of keeping stores full so nobody goes far, but he greets no one, offers no help, and just took berries and ate.
